# gcore_cloud_registry_users (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_registry_users" "example_cloud_registry_users" {
  project_id = 0
  region_id = 0
  registry_id = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `registry_id` (Number)

### Optional
